gen-vast-shadow-gf-comme: Vintage swagger on top, with a smooth modern body below. Vast Shadow is best at diagonals that match its horizontals in weight; Comme, a plain sans, is best at smooth curves and big lowercase.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-fragment-mono: Vast Shadow draws every stroke at a single width, built to grab attention. Fragment Mono, a monospace, is built for precision, with letters lined up like nails on a ruler.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-fresca: Fresca reads clean and light, with counters that stay open to the outside. Under the vintage flourish of Vast Shadow, paragraphs of this sans should glide along without catching on a single clotted curve.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-gafata: Loud vintage lettering up top, then a tall-lettered sans below. Vast Shadow handles the shouting, and Gafata, with its wide-eyed e and short stalks, keeps text going down smoothly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-geist: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width, giving it a tall, vintage, attention-grabbing look. Geist, a sans that sets words as solid blocks, does the steady reading while the heading handles the shouting.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-gidole: Open terminals and a neon-tube consistency make this plain sans read crisp and clean. Gidole is best at steady reading, while Vast Shadow is best at turning heads with its tall, vintage letters.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals make this plain sans friendly and easy going. Hedvig Letters Sans feels like a relaxed neighbor beside the constant-weight outlines of Vast Shadow.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-heebo: Heebo sets a tall central band of text, with curves that stop short instead of closing in. While Vast Shadow stops traffic with slim joins and vintage flair, this plain sans does the quiet reading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-guntur: Vintage flair up top, and a steel-cable plain sans underneath. Hind Guntur stands tall like stamped metal type, with clear gaps at its curve ends, beside the loud vintage letters of Vast Shadow.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru is a plain sans with lowercase tops near ascender height. Vast Shadow is best at vintage, uniform-width display letters, while Hind Mysuru is best at unthinned, open-mouthed text.
